content: If parameter Controller of CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. CANIF_DEV_- ERROR_DETECT equals ON ), the function CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLER to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.

If parameter Controller of CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. CANIF_DEV_- ERROR_DETECT equals ON ), the function CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLER to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.

If parameter Controller of CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. CANIF_DEV_- ERROR_DETECT equals ON ), the function CanIf_TTGetErrorLevel() shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROLLER to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
